name: Box Breathing

instructions.description: Sit or stand comfortably with an upright but relaxed posture.
Inhale gently through the nose for a steady count.
Pause briefly, then exhale for the same count and pause again before the next breath.
Repeat the equal inhale, hold, exhale, hold pattern smoothly.

performanceMetrics.notes: Choose a count that stays comfortable and calm.
Use equal-length phases such as four seconds each if comfortable.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Lengthen the exhale without adding breath holds if holds feel uncomfortable.

commentsNotes: Do not strain during the pauses.
Reduce the count if you feel air hunger.
